title: When the Garden Breaks
author: Edmund Amberdale
blurb: Zephyrine Dravenmoor, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
